items.t: CVT drive belt can wear out early
items.note: Honda extended CVT coverage to 7 years or 150,000 miles on updated cars; most are now past the time limit.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
items.note: Free under recall 23V858 (also 20V314, 21V215). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons can let air into the brakes
items.job: Bleed brakes or replace rear caliper pistons
items.note: Free under recall 18V777. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera screen can go blank
items.job: Update or replace display audio unit
items.note: Free under recalls 23V046 / 24V384. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear window can shatter when the defroster is on
items.note: Honda runs a free product update campaign for affected 2023 cars. Ask a dealer to check the VIN.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 23V782. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering can feel sticky or hard to turn
items.job: Replace steering gearbox worm wheel spring and regrease
items.note: Free under recall 24V744. Check the VIN first.
